Name: Gugugaga Farm Helper
Author: XI221
Description:
[size=4][b]Gugugaga Farm Helper / 咕咕嘎嘎农场小帮手[/b][/size]

A little penguin girl lives by your farmhouse door and helps tend your farm.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Waters your crops[/b] every morning (not on rainy days), then [b]pulls weeds and picks up twigs and stones[/b] anywhere on the farm.[/*]
[*][b]Backpack[/b]: fiber, wood and stone she collects go into her backpack. Click her with empty hands to open it and take things out. (If she has something to say, she talks first - click again.)[/*]
[*][b]Energy[/b]: every job costs energy. When she runs out she sits down and shouts [b]"Gugugaga!"[/b], then gets up now and then to wander around.[/*]
[*][b]Give her a fish[/b] to refill her energy - she'll get right back to work. (She tells you this herself.)[/*]
[*]Portraits, daily dialogue, gift tastes (loves fish!), and she shows on the social tab, calendar and map.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod into [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i].[/*]
[*]Run the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Config[/b][/size]
config.json is created after the first run:
[list]
[*]MaxEnergy (120) - energy per day[/*]
[*]WaterCost (1) / DebrisCost (2) - energy per job[/*]
[*]WorkRadius (0) - work range in tiles from the door, 0 = whole farm[/*]
[*]StrollRadius (10) - how far she wanders when tired[/*]
[*]RestMilliseconds (20000) - how long she sits before wandering[/*]
[*]ClearDebris (true) - pull weeds and pick up twigs and stones[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
Stardew Valley 1.6+ and SMAPI 4.0+.

[size=4][b]Tips[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Using NPC Map Locations? Set its NpcIconStyle to Vanilla to see her full face on the map.[/*]
[*]Multiplayer: only the host runs her behavior.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]中文说明[/b][/size]
一个企鹅小女孩住在你的农舍门口：每天浇水、拔草、捡枝条和石头，捡到的东西放在自己的背包里（空手点她就能打开）。体力用完会坐下喊「咕咕嘎嘎！」，歇一会儿还会四处溜达；送她一条鱼，体力立刻回满接着干活。支持中文和英文。
